storyLines: Hey, never enter the ^<font=CROOKED>^CAREER COUNSELING ROOM^</font>^.
Hey, hey, the students who entered there...
Hey, rumor says that they were 'removed' from the school.
Hey, guess they really set path for your future.
Hey... I thought it was some kind of lost and found.
Hey, if you lose something on the top floor
Hey, hey, DO NOT ENTER and just knock outside.
Hey, this is a gift for you.
